title: Declared operations — part of the A2App adapter's app part
description: requirement.md section 4.1 and Appendix B.2. Every operation belongs to exactly one declared module and carries typed params; an operation that acts on a record also names its entity and may declare when it applies.

readOnly.description: the operation has no side effects; safe to call freely, result cacheable. Absent = not asserted

idempotent.description: repeating the operation is safe; may be retried without an Idempotency-Key. Absent = not asserted

module.description: which declared module this operation appears under. MUST name one of manifest.modules — an operation with nowhere to appear is unreachable by the walk.

entity.description: the entity this operation acts on. Absent = module-level: it appears on the module screen only, never on a record.

appliesWhen.description: decides whether this operation is available on a given record. Requires `entity`. Comparisons over the record's own fields only; natural-language conditions are prohibited (requirement_A2App.md 3.4, consistent with 6.1).

params.description: typed parameters, using the A2App field vocabulary. Required: the record level renders this as the operation's signature. Arguments described in prose inside `description` do not satisfy this.

predicate.description: A schema-based predicate over a record's stored fields. Leaf forms compare one field; `all`/`any`/`not` compose them. Deliberately closed: every form is machine-evaluable and machine-explainable, so a blocked operation can state its own reason without a model composing one.
